name: web-decentralization-hero-glowing-chip-with-ripple-rings
title: 'Build The Future Of Decentralization' hero with a glowing 3D chip and concentric ripple rings on cream
whatItIs: A cream landing hero with a centred nav and 'Get Started' button, a bold headline 'Build The Future Of Decentralization', 'Get Started' and 'Watch Demo' buttons, a glowing gold-and-white 3D microchip at the centre of soft concentric ripple rings, three stat cards (1M+ Transactions, 120+ Validator Nodes, 99% Uptime) and partner logos below.
whatItMeans: Premium and calm; a warm cream palette and soft ripples make blockchain infrastructure feel trustworthy rather than cold.
techniques: Centre a glowing 3D object inside soft ripple rings.
Use a warm cream palette instead of the usual dark web3 look.
Float stat cards directly beneath the hero object.

vocabulary.definition: Concentric circles suggesting an emanating signal or wave.
A computer that verifies transactions on a blockchain network.
